meta.method: Unit prices were read from the public AWS Price List bulk API (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<offer>/<version>/ap-southeast-1/index.json), which is the machine-readable source behind aws.amazon.com/<service>/pricing. The 'source_detail' field names the usagetype / SKU description that was read. The human pricing pages (aws.amazon.com) and the Free Tier page could not be fetched from the build environment, so every free-tier allowance is marked with how it was verified.

verification_levels.verified_pricelist: Read directly from the AWS Price List API file named in source_detail on the retrieved date.
verification_levels.verified_official_snippet: Confirmed from an aws.amazon.com page excerpt returned by web search (page itself not fetched).
verification_levels.verified_secondary: Only third-party summaries of the official page were reachable; treat as likely but re-check before publication.
verification_levels.unverified: Could not be confirmed online in this session; the value is a best estimate and must not be presented as verified.

free_tier_regime.note: Accounts created on or after 2025-07-15 do not receive the legacy 12-month allowances; they receive Free Tier credits (up to US$200 over 6 months) plus the always-free allowances. Accounts created before that date keep the 12-month allowances for their first year. The model therefore applies always-free allowances by default and the 12-month allowances only with --legacy-free-tier.

meta.tiering_note: Where a dimension has volume tiers, 'usd' is the first-tier price and 'tiers' lists the full schedule as [upper_bound_of_tier, price]. At the 1k/10k/100k registrations-per-month tiers the project never leaves tier 1.

lambda_request_arm.source_detail: Price List AWSLambda version 20261014171944, usagetype APS1-Request-ARM: 'AWS Lambda - Total Requests for ARM - Asia Pacific (Singapore)' USD 0.0000002 per request. Free tier 1M requests/month: aws.amazon.com/free/serverless (secondary snippets).
lambda_request_arm.notes: US$0.20 per million requests, same as x86.

lambda_gbs_arm.source_detail: Price List AWSLambda version 20261014171944, usagetype APS1-Lambda-GB-Second-ARM Tier-1 USD 0.0000133334 per GB-s (x86 is USD 0.0000166667).
lambda_gbs_arm.notes: Billed per 1 ms; memory 512 MB (api, forwarder, sweep, notifier) and 1024 MB (worker) per app.yaml.

http_api_request.source_detail: Price List AmazonApiGateway version 20261013003044, usagetype APS1-ApiGatewayHttpRequest: '$1.25/million requests - API Gateway HTTP API (first 300 million)'.
http_api_request.notes: Requests are metered in 512 KB increments; all SeatRelay payloads are far below that. The 12-month allowance (1M HTTP API calls) was not confirmed by an official snippet in this session.

sqs_request_standard.source_detail: Price List AWSQueueService version 20260911124607, usagetype APS1-Requests-Tier1: '$0.40 per million Amazon SQS standard requests in Tier1 in Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
sqs_request_standard.notes: Every API action (Send, Receive, Delete, ChangeVisibility) is one request per 64 KB chunk. Used by expiry-delay queue and the two standard DLQs.

sqs_request_fifo.source_detail: Price List AWSQueueService version 20260911124607, usagetype APS1-Requests-FIFO-Tier1: '$0.50 per million Amazon SQS FIFO requests in Tier1 in Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
sqs_request_fifo.notes: The 1M free requests/month are pooled under sqs_request_standard (the free tier covers all queue types); the model applies the pool to standard first, then FIFO. Used by commands.fifo and commands-dlq.fifo.

ddb_rru_ondemand.source_detail: Price List AmazonDynamoDB version 20260911124422, usagetype APS1-ReadRequestUnits: '$0.1425 per million read request units (Asia Pacific (Singapore))'.
ddb_rru_ondemand.notes: 1 RRU = one strongly consistent read of up to 4 KB; eventually consistent = 0.5 RRU; transactional = 2 RRU. The DynamoDB free tier (25 WCU/25 RCU) applies to provisioned capacity only, so no request-unit allowance is modelled for PAY_PER_REQUEST.

ddb_wru_ondemand.source_detail: Price List AmazonDynamoDB version 20260911124422, usagetype APS1-WriteRequestUnits: '$0.71 per million write request units (Asia Pacific (Singapore))'.
ddb_wru_ondemand.notes: 1 WRU = one write of up to 1 KB; TransactWriteItems consumes 2 WRU per 1 KB (the worker commit is transactional, plan §2.3). GSI1 (Projection ALL) doubles writes of items that carry GSI1 keys; the per-command WRU estimate in the model already includes this.

ddb_storage_gb_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonDynamoDB version 20260911124422, usagetype APS1-TimedStorage-ByteHrs: '$0.00 per GB-Month of storage for first 25 free GB-Months' then '$0.285 per GB-Month'.
ddb_storage_gb_month.notes: The 25 GB allowance is encoded in the price list itself (first tier priced at 0).

ddb_streams_rru.source_detail: Price List AmazonDynamoDB version 20260911124422, usagetype APS1-Streams-Requests: '$0.00 for 2.5 million DynamoDB Streams read request units for a month (free tier)' then '$0.000000228 per DynamoDB Streams read request unit'.
ddb_streams_rru.notes: GetRecords calls made by a Lambda event-source mapping (our notifier) are not charged according to the DynamoDB pricing page; that statement could not be re-verified online in this session, so the model counts stream RRUs at 0 by default and prices them only with --charge-stream-reads.

ddb_pitr_gb_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonDynamoDB version 20260911124422, usagetype APS1-TimedPITRStorage-ByteHrs: '$0.228 per GB-Month of storage used for DynamoDB PITR backup'.
ddb_pitr_gb_month.notes: PITR is enabled on the table (app.yaml PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true); billed on table size, 35-day recovery window.

ses_email_essentials.source_detail: Price List AmazonSES version 20260911124507, usagetype APS1-Essentials-Outbound-Email: '$0.00016 per Count from 0 to 10,000,000'. Plans announced 2026-07-21: https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/07/amazon-ses-pricing-plans/
ses_email_essentials.notes: US$0.16 per 1,000. Accounts that start sending after 2026-07-21 begin on the Essentials plan, which is the SeatRelay case, so this is the default e-mail price in the model. The SES 12-month free tier (3,000 message charges/month) is closed to new customers since 2026-07-21 (verified_secondary).

ses_email_alacarte.free_12mo_unit: message charges/month (accounts that started SES before 2026-07-21 only)
ses_email_alacarte.source_detail: Price List AmazonSES version 20260911124507, usagetype APS1-Recipients (operation Send): 'USD0.0001 per Count for Recipients:Send in Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
ses_email_alacarte.notes: US$0.10 per 1,000; used only as a sensitivity (--ses-alacarte). Attachments are billed separately at US$0.12/GB; SeatRelay sends none.

cloudfront_dto_gb_asia.dimension: Data transfer out to internet, Asia Pacific edge locations
cloudfront_dto_gb_asia.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudFront version 20261003000426 (global file), usagetype AP-DataTransfer-Out-Bytes, fromLocation 'Asia Pacific' toLocation 'External': '$0.120 per GB - first 10 TB / month'. Free 1 TB/month: aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing (official snippet) and https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/aws-free-tier-data-transfer-expansion-100-gb-from-regions-and-1-tb-from-amazon-cloudfront-per-month/
cloudfront_dto_gb_asia.notes: PriceClass_200 includes Singapore (web.yaml); Asia Pacific is the most expensive class the SPA will be served from. Origin fetches from S3 to CloudFront are free.

cloudfront_https_request_asia.dimension: HTTPS requests, Asia Pacific edge locations
cloudfront_https_request_asia.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudFront version 20261003000426 (global file), usagetype AP-Requests-Tier2-HTTPS, location 'Asia Pacific': '$0.012 per 10,000 HTTPS Requests'.
cloudfront_https_request_asia.notes: The distribution redirects HTTP to HTTPS, so all billable requests are HTTPS.

s3_storage_gb_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonS3 version 20261015173540, usagetype APS1-TimedStorage-ByteHrs: '$0.025 per GB - first 50 TB / month of storage used'.
s3_storage_gb_month.notes: Only the SPA build (~10 MB) lives in S3; the SAM deployment bucket is similar in size.

s3_put_request.source_detail: Price List AmazonS3 version 20261015173540, usagetype APS1-Requests-Tier1: '$0.005 per 1,000 PUT, COPY, POST, or LIST requests'.

s3_get_request.source_detail: Price List AmazonS3 version 20261015173540, usagetype APS1-Requests-Tier2: '$0.004 per 10,000 GET and all other requests'.
s3_get_request.notes: Only CloudFront cache misses reach S3.

cw_custom_metric_month.dimension: Custom metrics (EMF), per metric per month
cw_custom_metric_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudWatch version 20261007115540, usagetype APS1-CW:MetricMonitorUsage: '$0.30 per metric-month for the first 10,000 metrics - Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
cw_custom_metric_month.notes: Each unique metric-name x dimension-set is one metric, hence the low-cardinality rule in plan §2.4 (only Service/Stage dimensions).

cw_alarm_month.dimension: Standard-resolution alarm, per alarm-metric per month
cw_alarm_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudWatch version 20261007115540, usagetype APS1-CW:AlarmMonitorUsage: '$0.10 per alarm metric month (standard resolution) - Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.

cw_dashboard_month.source_detail: Not present in the Price List API files (neither ap-southeast-1 nor us-east-1). US$3.00 per dashboard-month and 3 free dashboards are the figures quoted by third-party summaries of aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/pricing (e.g. cloudzero.com/blog/cloudwatch-pricing).
cw_dashboard_month.notes: Best estimate; the official page was not reachable from the build environment. Immaterial for the project (1 dashboard per stage, within the 3 free).

cw_logs_ingest_gb.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudWatch version 20261007115540, usagetype APS1-DataProcessing-Bytes (PutLogEvents): '$0.70 per GB custom log data ingested in Standard log class - Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
cw_logs_ingest_gb.notes: Singapore is priced above us-east-1 (US$0.50). Lambda function logs and the HTTP API access log both land here.

cw_logs_storage_gb_month.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudWatch version 20261007115540, usagetype APS1-TimedStorage-ByteHrs: '$0.03 per GB-mo of log storage - Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
cw_logs_storage_gb_month.notes: All log groups have RetentionInDays 14 (app.yaml), so average stored volume is about 14/30 of monthly ingestion.

cw_api_request.source_detail: Price List AmazonCloudWatch version 20261007115540, usagetype APS1-CW:Requests: '$0.01 per 1,000 requests'.
cw_api_request.notes: Dashboard refreshes and the experiment scripts' metric fetches; EMF metrics are ingested through logs, not this API.

xray_trace_recorded.source_detail: Price List AWSXRay version 20260911124622, usagetype APS1-XRay-TracesStored: 'AWS X-Ray - Total Traces Stored - Asia Pacific (Singapore)' USD 0.000005. Free 100,000 recorded + 1,000,000 retrieved/scanned: aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/pricing (official snippet).
xray_trace_recorded.notes: Tracing: Active on every function (app.yaml Globals). Default sampling rule records 1 request/s plus 5% of the rest; the model conservatively records one trace per sampled invocation with a configurable sampling fraction.

xray_trace_retrieved.source_detail: Price List AWSXRay version 20260911124622, usagetype APS1-XRay-TracesAccessed (operations XRay-Traces-Retrieved / XRay-Traces-Scanned): USD 0.0000005 per trace.
xray_trace_retrieved.notes: Only console/experiment look-ups; a small fixed quantity in the model.

eventbridge_scheduler_invocation.source_detail: Price List AWSEvents version 20260924163903, usagetype APS1-ScheduledInvocation: '$0 for the first 14 million scheduled invocations' then '$1.25 per million scheduled invocations in Asia Pacific (Singapore)'.
eventbridge_scheduler_invocation.notes: The sweep schedule (rate(5 minutes), ScheduleV2) makes 8,640 invocations in a 30-day month.

cognito_mau_essentials.free_always_unit: MAU/month (Lite or Essentials; no free tier on Plus)
cognito_mau_essentials.source_detail: Price List AmazonCognito version 20260925193108, usagetype APS1-CognitoEssentialsMAU: 'Cognito Essentials ap-southeast-1 tier 1 pricing' USD 0.015 per MAU. 10,000 free MAU: aws.amazon.com/cognito/pricing (official snippet: 'Amazon Cognito Essentials and Lite have a free tier ... that doesn't expire').
cognito_mau_essentials.notes: auth.yaml does not set UserPoolTier, so the pool is created on the default Essentials tier.

cognito_mau_lite.source_detail: Price List AmazonCognito version 20260925193108, usagetype APS1-CognitoLiteMAU: tier 1 USD 0.0055 (first 90,000 after the free 10,000), tier 2 USD 0.0046, tier 3 USD 0.00325, tier 4 USD 0.0025.
cognito_mau_lite.notes: Sensitivity option (--cognito-lite): Lite lacks managed login branding v2 and passwordless, neither of which SeatRelay uses.

data_transfer_out_gb.dimension: Data transfer out from ap-southeast-1 to the internet (API Gateway responses)
data_transfer_out_gb.source_detail: Price List AWSDataTransfer version 20260916132208, usagetype APS1-DataTransfer-Out-Bytes: '$0.120 per GB - first 10 TB / month data transfer out beyond the global free tier'. 100 GB free: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/aws-free-tier-data-transfer-expansion-100-gb-from-regions-and-1-tb-from-amazon-cloudfront-per-month/
data_transfer_out_gb.notes: Data transfer in is free. Lambda-to-DynamoDB/SQS traffic stays inside the region and is free.

sns_email_notification.source_detail: Price List AmazonSNS version 20260915151944, usagetype APS1-DeliveryAttempts-SMTP: 'First 1,000 Amazon SNS Email/Email-JSON Notifications per month are free' then '$2.00 per 100,000'.
sns_email_notification.notes: Alarm notifications only; a few per month.

sns_api_request.source_detail: Price List AmazonSNS version 20260915151944, usagetype APS1-Requests-Tier1: 'First 1,000,000 Amazon SNS API Requests per month are free' then '$0.50 per 1,000,000'.

sla_reference.note: Published AWS Service Level Agreements (monthly uptime commitment) used for the availability discussion in docs/COST.md. Values are from memory of aws.amazon.com/<service>/sla and were not re-fetched in this session.
